terms.gloss: a guild, a union of people in the same calling
evidence: Liv. 2.27.5: mercātōrum (a guild of merchants; Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: The Roman collēgia of craftsmen and traders were guilds, the nearest ancient thing to a union; name the trade in the genitive.
Traupman’s word, after the modern languages; not in Lewis & Short.

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency (printed page numbers): p. 397.
